P.V. Sindhu Advances to Japan Open Semifinals After China's Chen Yufei Loses Streak

Indian badminton player P.V. Sindhu has reached the semifinals of the Japan Open after defeating Chinese player Chen Yufei, who had lost her previous five matches against Sindhu. This is Sindhu's first appearance in the semifinals of the tournament since 2018. The win marks a significant milestone for Sindhu, who has been working to regain her form after a series of injuries.
